newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts brokerage firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts brokerage firms.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it initiated coverage Quick & Reilly Group Inc with an outperform rating, and started both Merrill Lynch and Co Inc and Charles Schwab Corp with neutral ratings.
-- said Quick & Reilly's shares are undervalued compared to other brokers.
-- said its shares can increase 25 percent in value and still sell at a multiple below many of its peers.
-- said Merrill Lynch will be on a roller coaster ride for remainder of year, driven by market and economic uncertainties and continued rumors of mergers within the brokerage industry.
-- expects Merrill Lynch to earn $7.85 a share in 1997 and $7.35 in 1998.
-- said Charles Schwab is fairly valued.
-- expects Scwab to earn $1.45 a share in 1997.
